Definition: thinned (as to the edge), i.e. sharp
BiblicalUsage: The word means thinned to the edge, sharp, and Ezekiel uses it once, for the sword God has set against the gates: it is made bright, it is wrapped up for the slaughter, that hearts may faint and ruins be multiplied.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sharpened sword is God's warning made bright, and a bright edge means judgment is no longer far off.
